library.blurb_zh: 四个好朋友拆开屋顶，把瘫痪的朋友放到耶稣面前；晚上湖上起了大风暴，耶稣一句话，风和浪都停了。
library.blurb_en: Four friends dig through a roof to bring their friend to Jesus; in a storm on the lake, Jesus tells the wind and waves to be still.
